assign.request: Phase 3 of ai-server: dev server exposes MCP tools over HTTP so every Claude session can query live tabs (pages/eval) and screenshot (shot) — the socket replaces playwright for DOM truth. Hand-rolled JSON-RPC, loopback-fenced, no deps.
steps: read MCP transport docs + Server plugin pattern

log.msg: Spec read: MCP streamable-HTTP (2025-11-25 lifecycle). Legacy `initialize` handshake is what Claude Code speaks; the draft's `server/discover` era (2026-07-28) is not needed. Single application/json reply per POST is legal (transport rule 5); a notification MUST get 202 with no body (rule 4). tools/list = {tools:[{name,description,inputSchema}]}; tools/call = {content:[{type:'text',text}], isError}. Version negotiation: echo the client's version if supported, else our latest.
.mcp.json shape confirmed against code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp: {"mcpServers": {"<name>": {"type": "http", "url": "…"}}}. Project scope, checked in, prompts for approval once.

assign.now: writing MCP.js — endpoint, loopback fence, three tools

action.did: Built the MCP endpoint: POST /mcp, hand-rolled JSON-RPC 2.0, loopback-fenced, three tools (pages/eval/shot). initialize echoes a supported protocolVersion (2025-11-25 … 2024-11-05) or offers our latest; notifications get 202/no-body; GET and DELETE get 405; unknown method -32601, unknown tool -32602, a failing tool returns isError instead of a protocol error.

Wired the browser end: Socket.open() announces `hello` with location.pathname, and Socket.eval(code, token) evaluates via indirect eval, awaits a promise result, JSON-serializes with a String() fallback for circular values, and replies `eval_result` — never throwing out of message dispatch. changed()/restyle() untouched.

log.msg: Split Tab out of MCP.js at 163 lines — CLAUDE.md's under-100 rule diagnosed it exactly (a second responsibility), and every other Socket plugin already lives in its own file. Now MCP.js 119 (28 of them tool schemas) + SocketServer/Tab.js 39; server.js registers `DevSocket.Socket.use(Tab)` beside Runtime/Ask/Start/Tail.

assign.now: verifying live against the restarted server

log.msg: Verified live at the endpoint (scratch node scripts, never in the repo). initialize echoes 2025-06-18 and offers 2025-11-25 for an unknown version; notifications/initialized -> 202 no body; tools/list -> three tools with valid schemas; GET /mcp -> 405. Real playwright tab on /framework/core/Page/: pages lists it with connected_since, eval returns document.title ("Page"), a structure, a promise (awaited), a circular value via String() -> [object Window], a ReferenceError as isError; shot returned a 37KB png that exists, and a missing selector came back isError. A never-settling promise resolved as 'the tab did not answer in 10s' at exactly 10.0s and the tab stayed usable; closing the tab settled a pending eval as 'the tab closed' and emptied pages.

Fence: 16/16 predicate cases pass (127.x, ::1, ::ffff:127.0.0.1, ::1%lo0 in; LAN, ::ffff:LAN, 0.0.0.0, fe80::, '127.0.0.1.evil.com', empty/undefined/null out). End-to-end too — the server binds 0.0.0.0, so POSTing http://192.168.1.206/mcp from this machine gave express a non-loopback remoteAddress: HTTP 403, JSON-RPC -32600, and 'MCP: REFUSED /mcp from 192.168.1.206' on the server console.

`claude mcp list` sees site -> http://localhost/mcp (HTTP) - Pending approval. That is the documented .mcp.json project-scope behavior: Mike approves once in an interactive `claude`. Not auto-approved from here — that is user config, not mine to write.

Known limit, documented in doc/wire.md: `hello` reports where a tab CONNECTED, and an SPA navigation changes location.pathname without a new socket — so pages goes stale until the next eval re-announces (eval() sends hello first, so it self-heals). Measured: after an in-page click, pages still said /framework/ until an eval, then /framework/core/. eval with no `path` takes the first tab and sidesteps it. The real fix is the router announcing navigation, which is not this task's file.

assign.now: landed — /mcp answers, three tools verified against a live tab, fence refuses a real LAN request
assign.outcome: POST /mcp speaks MCP streamable HTTP (single-JSON form) with pages/eval/shot; loopback-fenced and logged; dev Socket gained hello + eval + eval_result; .mcp.json checked in so every session in the repo gets mcp__site__*. Deviations: Tab split into Server/plugins/SocketServer/Tab.js (MCP.js was 163 lines with a second responsibility) so server.js takes two registrations, not one; eval awaits a promise result. Follow-up for the doc agent: dev/Socket/page.js `methods:` + a doc/method/eval.md — page.js was another agent's file.

log.msg: Orchestrator closed the named follow-up: dev/Socket page.js methods gained eval; doc/method/eval.md written (usage, the two-gate security model, the never-throw property); doc/file/Socket.js.md gained the MCP-reply-channel section and improvement 5 now admits the third job has arrived. page.js node --check clean.
